fact: Revenue Services Lesotho says its Automatic Compliance Project, built with the Land Administration Authority, will use data analytics and artificial intelligence to automate collection, processing and verification of tax information, in phases starting with PAYE pre-population.
Qure.ai's account says its qXR chest X-ray AI has screened for TB at seven community sites in Lesotho with Partners In Health and the Ministry of Health since July 2022.
Qure.ai reports that qXR has processed over 6,000 scans since July 2022 and identified about 1,100 people with potential TB for GeneXpert confirmation.

Minister Nthati Moorosi said her ministry is developing a proposed AI chatbot with the Ministry of Agriculture, Food Security and Nutrition to give farmers advice through agricultural extension services.
WHO AFRO says the Government of Lesotho has implemented innovations including using artificial intelligence to aid TB screening.
